Short Rest regains one Wild Shape use. Long Rest resets HP, Wild Shape and spell slots.

Wildfire Spirit

Summon: Action, expend a Wild Shape use. Creatures of your choice within 10 ft. of its appearance make a DEX save (DC 15) or take 2d6 fire damage.

AC 13 · HP 30 · Speed 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (hover)

Flame Seed: +7 to hit, 1d6+3 fire, range 60 ft.

Fiery Teleportation: spirit and willing creatures within 5 ft. teleport up to 15 ft. Creatures near its departure make a DEX save or take 1d6+3 fire.

Acts immediately after your turn. Takes the Dodge action unless you command it with your Bonus Action.

Wild Shape

Uses left2 uses · Short Rest +1 · Long Rest all

Bonus Action to assume a form, and a Bonus Action to leave early. Lasts 2 hours (half druid level) or until you use Wild Shape again, are Incapacitated, or die. You gain 5 Temporary Hit Points (druid level). Known forms: 6, max CR 1/2, no Fly speed; replace one after a Long Rest. Your stats become the beast's, but you keep HP, Hit Dice, INT/WIS/CHA, class features, languages, feats, and your skill and save proficiencies (the beast's bonus is used where higher). You can't cast spells while shifted, but Concentration is not broken. Equipment falls, merges (no effect) or is worn by the form, as you choose; the DM decides what is practical.

Wild Resurgence LV5

Once on each of your turns, if you have no Wild Shape uses left, expend a spell slot to regain one use (no action). You can also expend a use to gain one level 1 slot, once per Long Rest.

Darkvision — 60 ft.

The upload listed only the Infernal language, which is a 2014 trait. 2024 Tieflings use the three traits above.

Druid Features

Druidic — secret druid language; leave hidden messages (others notice them with DC 15 Investigation but cannot read them without magic). Speak with Animals is always prepared.
Spellcasting — Wisdom-based prepared spells; druidic focus.
Primal Order MAGICIAN, PROVISIONAL — extra druid cantrip and a WIS bonus to Arcana or Nature.
Warden: martial weapons and medium armor training instead.
Wild Shape — transform into known beast forms, or summon your Wildfire Spirit.
Wild Companion — Magic action: expend a spell slot or a Wild Shape use to cast Find Familiar without material components. The familiar is Fey and vanishes when you finish a Long Rest.
Wild Resurgence LV5 — trade spell slots and Wild Shape uses under the class rules.

Circle of Wildfire

Circle Spells — always prepared: Burning Hands, Cure Wounds, Flaming Sphere, Scorching Ray, Plant Growth, Revivify.
Summon Wildfire Spirit — a fiery companion powered by Wild Shape.
Wildfire theme — destruction clears space for new growth. The spirit is a separate creature, not a mount.
War Caster LV4 FEAT — chosen instead of an Ability Score Improvement.
This build assumes the 2024 Druid chassis with the Circle of Wildfire subclass adapted from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything. DM approval recommended.

Magical Items

Moon Sickle +1 UNCOMMON · DRUID ATTUNEMENT
+1 to attack and damage with it, plus +1 to spell attack rolls and save DCs of druid spells while held. Works as a druidic focus. Healing spells add 1d4 (1d4). Found among the possessions of a ruined roadside shrine.
Cloak of Protection UNCOMMON · ATTUNED
+1 AC and +1 to all saving throws while worn. A reward from a caravan warden after a dangerous crossing.

Attunement slots: 2 / 3 when both are attuned. Baseline stats assume neither; use the gear toggles at the top. Both attuned: AC 16, spell attack +8, DC 16, saves +1.
